description: This file defines a Flutter widget called HomeScreen, which serves as the main screen for a restaurant app. It displays various informational cards about the restaurant's heritage, operating hours, location, user authentication status, and seasonal promotions, along with navigation actions.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that represents the main screen of the restaurant app, displaying various information and navigation options.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including app bar, list view with info cards, and conditional login/welcome components.
